### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

Unicorn Engine ============== **LOOKING FOR CONTRIBUTORS!** See [this](https://github.com/unicorn-engine/unicorn/issues/2237). ============== Unicorn is a lightweight, multi-platform, multi-architecture CPU emulator framework, based on [QEMU](http://qemu.org). Unicorn offers some unparalleled features: - Multi-architecture: ARM, ARM64 (ARMv8), M68K, MIPS, PowerPC, RISCV, SPARC, S390X, TriCore and X86 (16, 32, 64-bit) - Clean/simple/lightweight/intuitive architecture-neutral API - Implemented in pure C language, with bindings for Crystal, Clojure, Visual Basic, Perl, Rust, Ruby, Python, Java, .NET, Go, Delphi/Free Pascal, Haskell, Pharo, Lua and Zig. - Native support for Windows & *nix (with
